question: How is the unmanifest reality attainable through yoga characterized here?
premises: The reality has an unmanifest form.
It is delightful and always attainable through yoga.
This is addressed to the beloved.
inference: The unmanifest reality is delightful and perpetually accessible through yogic practice.
uncertainties: This verse likely completes the thought begun in verse 191.
plain_english: O beloved, the delightful, unmanifest-formed reality, always attainable through yoga.
